items.source: Return true if this lookup is immutable and has contents that will never change.
items.translation: 如果此查找是不可变的且其内容将永远不会改变，则返回true。

items.source: Return the implicit prefix that is applied when performing a lookup or null if no prefix is used. Prefixes can be used to disambiguate keys that would otherwise clash. For example, if multiple applications are running on the same machine a different prefix can be set on each application to ensure that different environment variables are used.
items.translation: 返回执行查找时应用的隐式前缀，或者如果未使用前缀则返回`null`。可以使用前缀来消除键的歧义，否则这些键可能会发生冲突。例如，如果在同一台机器上运行多个应用程序，可以为每个应用程序设置不同的前缀，以确保使用不同的环境变量。

items.source: the prefix applied by the lookup class or null.
items.translation: 由查找类应用的名称前缀或null。

items.source: Interface that can be optionally implemented by a PropertySource to provide additional information.
items.translation: 可选由 PropertySource 实现的接口，用于提供额外信息。

items.source: Return the implicit prefix that is applied when performing a lookup or null if no prefix is used.
items.translation: 返回执行查找时应用的隐式前缀，或者如果未使用前缀则返回null。
